name: Add a routing rule
description: Add a routing rule Add a single routing rule to a project at a specified position. POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes
context:
POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes
Add a single routing rule to a project at a specified position. Defaults to the end of the list if no position is provided. The route is enabled by default. Stages a new version with the added route.
Required: projectId (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Delete routing rules
description: Delete routing rules Delete one or more routing rules from a project by ID. DELETE /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes
context:
DELETE /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes
Delete one or more routing rules from a project by ID. Stages a new version with the routes removed.
Required: projectId (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Edit a routing rule
description: Edit a routing rule Replace a routing rule identified by its ID, or restore it from the current production version. PATCH /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes/{routeId}
context:
PATCH /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes/{routeId}
Replace a routing rule identified by its ID, or restore it from the current production version. Stages a new version with the modified route.
Required: projectId (path); routeId (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Generate a routing rule from natural language
description: Generate a routing rule from natural language Generate a routing rule configuration from a natural language description. POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes/generate
context:
POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes/generate
Generate a routing rule configuration from a natural language description. Returns a suggested route configuration that can be reviewed and saved.
Required: projectId (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Get project routing rules
description: Get project routing rules Get the routing rules for a project. GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes
context:
GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes
Get the routing rules for a project. Supports searching by name/ID/pattern, filtering by route type, and diffing staged changes against production.
Required: projectId (path)
Optional: versionId (query); q (query); filter (query); diff (query); teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Get routing rule version history
description: Get routing rule version history Get the version history for a project's routing rules. GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes/versions
context:
GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes/versions
Get the version history for a project's routing rules. Returns the staging version (if one exists) followed by production versions, most recent first. The staging version has `isStaging: true` and the current production version has `isLive: true`.
Required: projectId (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Stage routing rules
description: Stage routing rules Stage routing rules for a project. PUT /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes
context:
PUT /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes
Stage routing rules for a project. Set `overwrite` to true to replace all existing rules, or omit it to merge with existing rules by ID. Returns the new staged version.
Required: projectId (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Promote, restore, or discard a routing rule version
description: Promote, restore, or discard a routing rule version Promote staged routing rules to production, restore a previous production version, or discard staged changes. POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes/versions
context:
POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes/versions
Promote staged routing rules to production, restore a previous production version, or discard staged changes. - `promote`: Publishes the staging version to production. - `restore`: Rolls back to a previous production version. - `discard`: Removes the staging version without publishing.
Required: projectId (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)
